caseNameFull: Will D. Gould v. Leo V. Youngworth, United States Marshal Warren Gillelen v. Leo V. Youngworth, United States Marshal and Lee R. Myers v. H. Z. Osborne, United States Marshal
summary: Appeals from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Southern District of California.
attorneys: Mr. Will' D. Gould for appellants in No. 401 and Mr. Herbert J. Goudge for appellants in No. 415. The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant-Attorney General Sanford for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Final orders reversed with costs, and causes remanded-with directions to discharge petitioners, respectively, without prejudice to renewal of applications to remove, on the authority of Tinsley v. Treat &c., 205 U. S. 20.
